errors.evidence: The description states that the period covered is from 1980 to 2018. However, the x-axis labels only go up to 2015, and the data line itself ends around 2017, not 2018.
The description states that the line for Bulgaria starts at around 125% in 1980. Visually, the line starts at a lower value, closer to 110%.

errors.text_span: продължавайки да спада до около 25–30% към 2018 г.
errors.evidence: The description states the value for Bulgaria drops to 25-30% towards 2018. While the value is correct, the year is not; this level is reached around 2010 and maintained until the end of the graph (c. 2017), not specifically towards 2018.

errors.text_span: Червената линия, означена като „OECD“, е хоризонтална и се намира точно на ниво 25%
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the red line representing OECD is at the 25% level. The chart clearly shows this line is a flat horizontal line at the 0% level.
